issues.title: Refactor target synchronization to Observer pattern
issues.intent: Move target sync into an Observer so it can run through Laravel queues.
issues.acceptance: Opt-in observer/job path; no target writes in the request thread with an async queue; worker performs create/update/delete changes; queue_connection/queue_name honoured; ids-only payload; replay/out-of-order contract; job writes do not dispatch new jobs.
issues.scope_limits: Not: concurrent-worker ordering (F03), tenant context (F02), durable delivery (F09).
issues.evidence: tested now (full suite on the head 03f6200, real mongodb queue test)
issues.release: blocked by F01-F03 P0 items (see feature matrix)
issues.missing: Per-save vs per-operation dispatch is F08 (one updateWithSync dispatches 2 jobs per relation, observed on the head).

issues.title: Command Analyse Database
issues.intent: Find out-of-sync relationships (a document referencing a target that lacks the reverse projection).
issues.acceptance: See PROMPT section 6: discovery, error classes, inverse checks, exit codes, read-only default, bounded repair jobs, no recreated targets, conflicts, repair -> worker -> clean rescan.
issues.scope_limits: Presence checks only; F05 (JSON, checkpoints, stale/duplicate findings) is separate.
issues.evidence: tested now (full suite on the head 03f6200, incl. end-to-end repair with queue:work)
